title: Apple Stem Cell Extract for Hair: What the Research Shows
seo_title: Apple Stem Cell Extract for Hair: Evidence & Side Effects | FullyVital
seo_description: What apple stem cell extract is, why the hair research is on apple procyanidin B2 instead, and what trials and side-effect data show.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.

Old post (1,803 words, 0 study links) promised hair growth and anti-aging from apple stem cell extract with no source. Rewritten to separate the cosmetic ingredient (no hair trial found) from apple procyanidin B2 (which has two human trials).
flags: The closing FullyVital product box (unchanged, sitewide) says products 'Promote Hair Regrowth'. Left for you, as with boron.
Kamimura 2000 concluded procyanidin B-2 'shows potential as a safe and promising cure for male pattern baldness'. The article reports the measured hair counts only and does not repeat 'cure'.
Both hair trials are on apple polyphenols, not 'stem cell extract'. If your product uses stem cell extract, the evidence doesn't transfer. This is the one to be careful about on the product pages.
